'''Fashti''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Inania]], a [[Mahea|Mahean]] economy and the nineteenth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city is the political, financial and cultural centre of [[Inania]].
